data.title: Request for missing documents for mortgage financing
data.summary: Musterbank Lüne eG asks Ruben Beispielgaard to submit his last three payslips, the land register extract (Grundbuchauszug) and the declaration of division (Teilungserklärung) needed to process his financing request for the flat at Wiesengrund 23, within 8 working days of the letter; otherwise the offered interest rate can no longer be guaranteed.
data.explanation: Your bank still needs three documents to finish checking your mortgage application: your last three payslips, the land register extract, and the declaration of division for the flat you want to buy. Send these by the deadline shown in the app, which counts working days (Saturdays count, Sundays and holidays don't) from the day after this letter's date. If you miss it, the bank says it can no longer guarantee the interest rate it offered you, so it's worth sending the documents as soon as possible or contacting the bank if you need more time.
